kevin: For the docs site, include a tiny screenshot of the devcontainer popup and call out that Remote - Containers is optional. I9ll add a 1-line redirect for the old docker URL.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 by maya (labels: docs, quickstart, devcontainer).
